harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured ufw on node1 (Ubuntu 24.04) with default-deny incoming / allow outgoing, explicit allow rules for 22/tcp (SSH) and 8080/tcp, enabled the ufw systemd service for boot persistence, verified live behavior (SSH open, unrelated port 9999 refused), then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified ufw was active/enabled with the same rules and correct allow/reject behavior post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 24.04.3) and available firewall tooling (ufw present, inactive)
Reset and configured ufw: default deny incoming, allow outgoing, allow 22/tcp, allow 8080/tcp
Enabled ufw and the ufw systemd unit (enabled at boot)
Verified nft ruleset backing ufw shows accept rules for dport 22 and 8080
Tested live: SSH port reachable, arbitrary port 9999 connection refused
Captured pre-restart boot_id as baseline
Issued `systemctl reboot` on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec was available again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified ufw status active/enabled with identical rules post-restart, and re-tested SSH open / port 9999 rejected

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080, rejects other inbound (pre-restart)
evidence.summary: Baseline showed ufw inactive; configured ufw with default-deny incoming and explicit allow for 22/tcp and 8080/tcp, enabled on boot; verified nft rules and live tests showing SSH open and port 9999 refused

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id f9bf293d...; issued systemctl reboot with returned acknowledgement; node became unreachable then reachable again with boot_id changed to 1a692a7c...; post-restart verification confirmed ufw active/enabled, correct rules, SSH reachable, and unrelated port 9999 rejected
